correctness.rationale: Substitute the central generator in the weight-zero identity; nondegenerate symplectic pairing forces u=0, and the remaining identity is (A-cI)^T J(A-cI)=c²J. c!=0 gives G_m x Sp_(2n) x A^(2n), dimension 2n²+3n+1. c=0 means isotropic image; its full incidence-vector-bundle over Lagrangian Grassmannian is irreducible with dimension (5/2)n(n+1). For n>=2 explicit rank-two A has isotropic column image but nonisotropic row image; the dual symplectic relation holds on generic closure, so the special component cannot be contained. For n=1 every singular matrix is approached from generic locus. Surjective image-rank count produces the exact all-q polynomial. Independently enumerated all 2^16 four-by-four matrices over F2: 3376 special and 720 generic, giving 65536 with center functionals.
